text:
Alex Monroe: Posting a quick design pass request for the alerting preview + threshold micro-panel. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique (frames: alert/mini-preview-ux). Need copy alignment + accessibility checks before next staging.

Priya Kapoor: Noted a couple things: 1) the channel list shows alphabetic order which hides the actual routing chain, 2) the tiny priority badge is easy to miss on dark mode.

Jon Castillo: For badges, suggest a filled circle with a small number (1,2...) and a tooltip that reads "Routing priority: 1 (primary)." Also, show an inline helper when theres a fallback so users understand cascade behavior.

Sasha Ivanov: Copy inconsistency: elsewhere we say both "Snooze for" and "Pause for". To reduce confusion, let's pick "Snooze for" for ephemeral rules and "Pause notifications" for global settings. Keep modal/action copy distinct.

Priya Kapoor: Accessibility issues: pills are grouped into one tabindex, keyboard users can't reach each channel. Add per-pill tabindex and aria-pressed. Also the priority badges should have an accessible name, e.g., aria-label="Priority 1".

Alex Monroe: Good split on copy — that could help users distinguish scope. For the preview CTA, what's everyone's take: keep "Apply" or change to "Save changes" or "Save preview"?

Jon Castillo: "Save changes" reads as persisted which is accurate for the panel. "Save preview" could imply the preview is ephemeral. I vote "Save changes".

Sasha Ivanov: a11y addition: when the preview recalculates (e.g., route policy changes), announce: "Preview updated: PagerDuty will receive alert first; Slack will be fallback." Use aria-live="polite" on an announcer div. Also add aria-posinset/aria-setsize on listitems for order semantics.

Priya Kapoor: Mobile layout note: the compact threshold + numeric input stack too tightly. Proposal: collapse the slider into a single-line control that surfaces numeric input by default on small widths, keep full slider on >=tablet.

Alex Monroe: Action list: @Priya implement per-pill tabindex + aria labels and mobile collapse, @Jon add compact priority badge mock + tooltip copy, @Sasha add aria-live announcer and update accessible names. I'll update Figma CTA to "Save changes" and adjust dark-mode badge contrast.

Preview-Bot: Staging deploy queued: build 2026-04-01T12:00Z (branch: feat/mini-preview-badges).

Jon Castillo: One visual polish idea: animate a faint connecting line from primary -> fallback when users toggle inclusion to make cascade behavior obvious. Will mock in proto.

Sasha Ivanov: I'll draft the accessibility checklist for the PR: per-pill focus, aria-pressed, aria-posinset/setsize, aria-live announcer, badge labels, numeric announcements for slider.

Alex Monroe: Thanks all — let's review changes in design sync Friday 2pm. :rocket:
